name: Ajax Login and Register Modal
description: Renders login, registration and password-reset forms in an AJAX modal.
project_description:
This module is provided an ability to login and register and rest password with AJAX in Modal dialogs or Non-modal dialogs or off canvas dialogs. This module provides a block with links to whatever you enabled from settings for the anonymous user.

After clicking on one of these links' user will be able to see a requested form in Ajax modal window or off canvas, whatever selected from settings. Submission and validation are being made with AJAX.

Also, there is available special configuration for this block and modal window for this module.

You can specify a kind of redirection or choose size parameters for current modal window, etc.
